readings: Compute each equipment's average relative humidity (scanenvironment.humepct, ignoring NULL readings), grouped by equipref. The all-equipment average is the mean of these per-equipment averages, so each equipment counts once. Keep equipment whose average is above that all-equipment average. The group mean is the mean of the per-equipment averages within this above-average group. For the top 10 by difference from the group mean, show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much it exceeds the all-equipment average, and its difference from the group mean. If either reference average is NULL, return no rows. Sort by difference from the group mean from highest to lowest, with NULLs last.

Compute each equipment's average relative humidity (scanenvironment.humepct, ignoring NULL readings), grouped by equipref. The all-equipment average is the pooled mean of every non-NULL humepct reading in scanenvironment, so equipment with more readings weigh more. Keep equipment whose own average is above that pooled average. The group mean is the pooled mean of all non-NULL humepct readings belonging to those above-average equipment. For the top 10 by difference from the group mean, show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much it exceeds the pooled all-equipment average, and its difference from the pooled group mean. If either reference average is NULL, return no rows. Sort by difference from the group mean from highest to lowest, with NULLs last.
queries:
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_h
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_h > overall.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS group_avg FROM above
)
SELECT
  above.equipref,
  above.avg_h AS average_humidity,
  above.avg_h - overall.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_average,
  above.avg_h - grp.group_avg AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above, overall, grp
WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND grp.group_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
per_equip AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_hum
  FROM per_equip p, overall o
  WHERE p.avg_hum > o.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.humepct) AS group_avg
  FROM scanenvironment s
  WHERE s.humepct IS NOT NULL
    AND s.equipref IN (SELECT equipref FROM above)
)
SELECT a.equipref,
       a.avg_hum AS avg_humidity,
       a.avg_hum - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg,
       a.avg_hum - g.group_avg AS diff_from_group_avg
FROM above a, overall o, grp g
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
